messages:
jess-support: Hey team — customer ACCT-432 opened a billing ticket: their invoice shows 4,312 tokens billed but their JS SDK estimator (v0.8.7) reports ~3,987 for the same request. They included request_id=req_0a1b2c and a sample payload. Can eng confirm why server vs client counts differ?

mike-eng: Thanks, Jess. Can you paste the exact messages they sent (system + messages + any function/tool usage)? differences usually come from post-send assistant/tool output or system message trimming.

jess-support: Pasted below (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-13b-instruct",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Summarize these logs and give remediation steps."},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"CALL_FUNCTION","name":"run-log-analysis"}  
  ],
  "functions": [ {"name":"run-log-analysis","arguments_schema":"..."} ]
}
```
Customer said the function returned ~1.1k tokens of analysis text, then assistant appended a small follow-up. SDK estimator only counted ~3.9k.

mike-eng: This lines up with a known gap in the older SDK estimator: it tokenizes the outbound message list at send time but doesn't add tokens produced by tool outputs or assistant messages that are generated server-side after a function call. Server-side billing includes the entire transcript (prompt + function output + final assistant turn).

ryan-ops: We also saw small differences from tokenizer variations and padding in the estimator: older SDK used an approximate tokenizer (fast heuristic) and sometimes rounds down. For requests with large function outputs the delta can be ~5-15%.

tokenizer-bot: Internal tokenizer check (server-side canonical tokenizer):
```
> request_id: req_0a1b2c
prompt_tokens: 2150
function_output_tokens: 1162
assistant_final_tokens: 1000
total_tokens: 4312
```
Estimator (js-sdk v0.8.7) returned 3987. Delta = 325 tokens (~8%).

mike-eng: Root cause summary: two factors. 1) SDK v0.8.7 estimates only the outbound message list before any function/tool output. 2) estimator tokenizer mismatch: older estimate uses a simpler token count and doesn't include some system padding and function metadata tokens we add server-side for routing/security.

jess-support: Customer asked whether we can reconcile invoice — they run at scale and want accuracy. Any mitigation for them immediately?

dan-billing: For invoice adjustments we need a verified discrepancy >$500 or clear server-side error. This one is ~325 tokens (~$7), so doesn't meet auto-adjust threshold. We can offer a goodwill credit once we confirm the behavior and recommend SDK upgrade; I'll hold until eng confirms.

mike-eng: Actionable items:
- Repro steps for support to run and share: a minimal script that triggers a function call returning a long string. Example curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-instruct","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Make a long report"},{"role":"assistant","content":"CALL_FUNCTION","name":"fake-run"}],"functions":[{"name":"fake-run","response":"<long text>"}] }'
```
- Support: capture request_id and attach whole server-side token breakdown (we can fetch it from the metering logs).
- Recommend customer upgrade to sdk-js v0.9.3 which includes post-call token estimates and uses canonical tokenizer.

jess-support: I'll send the repro script to the customer and ask them to run with debug logs. Also giving upgrade link and suggesting they try the latest SDK.

ryan-ops: Quick note — we patched the runtime earlier this quarter to avoid silently trimming function metadata; older runtime builds would add small metadata tokens after validation. If the customer's calls hit an older pool, that can add ~20-80 tokens. I can check their region/cluster if you give me req id.

mike-eng: Verified: req_0a1b2c landed on cluster eu-prod-2 (old runtime build). That explains ~45 tokens. Combined with function output being counted server-side explains the full delta.

dan-billing: Given the breakdown and that it's an explainable estimator difference + runtime version, billing won't change past invoice, but offer one-time $25 credit as goodwill? That should keep them happy. Jess, if customer accepts we can apply.

jess-support: Customer accepted the credit and will try the SDK upgrade. I'll mark the ticket resolved if we don't see further deltas. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

mike-eng: Long term: we'll update SDK docs to clearly call out post-function-call tokens and add an endpoint to request a pre-billing dry-run that uses the canonical tokenizer (we can ship a telemetry flag to the SDKs). Filed infra-ticket INF-2115.

tokenizer-bot: Reference: internal doc on token accounting -> https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/token-accounting (shared)

ryan-ops: Closing notes: if you see a customer with >1k unexplained delta, ping me + dan-billing and we'll pull server logs and cluster version.

jess-support: Closing thread — resolving ticket with credit applied.
